items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I'd hear him play with six pieces, something like that.

ctx.x: I mean how long since he died, about 1946 I believe, but when did he stop playing? Do you remember when you heard him, how you were?

No, I heard him, I remember he used to play, long years ago, there was different stores, would have a band to play out in front, and so forth like that, and I'd hear him play with six pieces, something like that. Well then he would be playing, you know, jazz, by head or something like that. But when he'd play on the roof guard and all that place up there, the tempo. Oh yeah. Well everybody was reading.

I was wondering if he played much like at the time that you went to Chicago, was he still active as a musician then? Yeah. Still working? Yeah. Yeah. Well 1930, even by Buddy McKee's death, he was still? Yeah, he was playing. Still playing. Mm-hmm. I'm going to ask a little bit about Kid Rene, if you heard him very much, how he played. I even met him and heard him play, but he was not very well when I heard him. Well when you heard him, he was shot up then.
